hotspot_events.title: Rare-Earth Export-Control Tightening Expected; NdFeB Stocking Costs Under Pressure
hotspot_events.heat_reason: Expected 'technology + items' dual rare-earth export controls raise NdFeB magnet stocking costs; motor/fan supply chains need to add safety stock early
hotspot_events.summary: October rare-earth market broadly flat: PrNd oxide ~RMB 741,000/ton on 10-19; Baotou Q4 rare-earth concentrate related-party price RMB 38,769/ton (+0.53% QoQ); expected tightening of rare-earth export controls (dual technology + items controls) will raise stocking costs and supply risk for NdFeB permanent-magnet motors/fans (inference: NdFeB is the core magnet material for high-efficiency motors/fans, and dysprosium/terbium — the key additives — are the control targets).
